[b]Hello again Demon Hunters! o/[/b]

We humbly apologize for the recent lapse in communication through Steam. Sadly, health hurdles momentarily hindered our updates. However, fear not! Our plucky indie team has been relentlessly toiling away behind the scenes to amplify our game.

As we battled our own demons (not the exhilarating kind we pursue in-game!), we remained steadfast in refining our creation to deliver an even more gripping experience. Anticipate updates on our ongoing demon-hunting escapades! 🎮👾💥

Your unwavering support and patience are invaluable as we continue our quest for gaming greatness! 🌟💪

[u]These verses carry our New Year wishes to you, Demon Hunters![/u] 🎉🌟

[b]In the New Year, seek demons’ might, 🔍👾
Hunt them down with skill and sight. 🎯✨
May your victories be grand, battles bold, 🏆🔥
A year of gaming thrills, yet untold! 🎮🌟[/b]

[b]Wishing hunts of demons, great and grand, 🌌🎮
A New Year filled with triumphs firsthand! 🎉💪
Action-packed days, victories bright, 🌟🎉
May the New Year bring gaming delight! 🎮✨"[/b]

In our forthcoming update, get ready to witness significant enhancements and optimizations that will elevate your gaming experience to new heights:

We are actively working on improving optimization through DLSS for Nvidia 20+ series cards and FSR for AMD cards. This optimization extends to Nvidia 10+ series cards as well, significantly boosting FPS by 50% to even 150%, depending on the player's hardware setup. FSR also functions seamlessly on Nvidia 10+ series cards, providing enhanced performance for a broader range of players.

[list]
[*] Introducing DLSS support exclusively for Nvidia 20+ series graphics cards, ensuring smoother and more immersive visuals for supported hardware. 🖥️✨

[*] Embrace the power of FSR, available for both AMD and Nvidia 10+ graphics cards, unlocking a substantial FPS boost of 50% to 150% across various hardware configurations. 🚀🎮

[*] Experience minor AI improvements, enhancing the game's overall intelligence for more engaging encounters. 🤖🔧

[*] We've also dedicated efforts to resolve minor environmental bugs, ensuring a seamless and polished gameplay environment. 🌍🐛
[/list]

Prepare for these improvements and stay tuned for an update that's geared towards maximizing performance and delivering a more refined gameplay experience! 🎮✨

[b]Announcing a 50% discount on our game until January 6, 2024! Join the demon-hunting action at an unbeatable price. [/b]🎮👾💥

[b]And that's not all! Stay tuned for a discounted price during the upcoming FPS Steam Fest. Don't miss out on another chance to grab Bloodhound at a great price! [/b]🎉🔥

Thank you for standing by us! Dive into the game fearlessly and take on every challenge with confidence! 🙌💫

[b]Check out our FREE DLC: [/b]

"Bring the Bloodhound world fully into the retro dimension 🕹️ and enjoy juicy old-style gameplay! o7. 🎉 Dive in and embrace the challenge! 🎮🔥"

notes.title: Introducing Patch 1.9.4 for Bloodhound's Prologue!
notes.content:
Greetings, Bloodhound community! We're excited to bring you the latest update for Bloodhound's Prologue, packed with improvements and enhancements based on your feedback. This patch focuses on rebalancing gameplay mechanics, optimizing performance, and addressing various issues. Here's what you can expect:

[list]
[*] Rebalanced Demon Form damage against regular enemies.
[*] Upgraded Demon Form now includes damage reduction during its duration.
[*] Improved optimization through better resource management, resulting in smoother gameplay.
[*] Fixed a mismatched cluster in Act 1, ensuring a more cohesive experience.
[*] Increased music volume by 30% to enhance the atmospheric immersion.
[*] Added a hidden pickup, the Golden Bullet, on Act 1 Map 1. Can you find it?
[*] Rebalanced enemy health on the normal difficulty level.
[*] Rebalanced enemy health on the hard difficulty level.
[*] Fixed pathfinding issues for flying enemies, improving their navigation.
[/list]

We hope these changes will further enhance your Bloodhound experience and provide a more balanced and optimized journey through the Prologue. As always, we greatly appreciate your ongoing support and valuable feedback. If you encounter any issues or have suggestions for future updates, please don't hesitate to reach out to us.

Enjoy the updated gameplay and immerse yourself in the dark and thrilling world of Bloodhound's Prologue!

The Bloodhound Team

notes.title: Patch 1.9.1 Live
notes.content:
Greetings Bloodhound fans! We are excited to announce the release of our latest patch for the Bloodhound Prologue - First Day In Hell. This patch brings many changes and improvements to the game that we are sure you will enjoy. Below is a list of the major changes that this patch introduces:

[list]
[*] Removed radial menu for power-ups
[*] Power-ups now appear on the player HUD
[*] Bindings now dedicated to specific power-ups for more intuitive use
[*] Boss power-up usage is now determined by the selected difficulty level
[*] Pickup positions have been adjusted, and new pickups added
[*] Rebalanced enemy numbers on act1map1 at the start of the game
[*] Cultist shotgun now moves away from the player when too close
[*] Bishop AI has been tweaked, and teleportation VFX added
[*] Priestess hit reaction has been improved to eliminate previous lag
[*] Range limit added for all spells
[*] Resurrection cooldown has been implemented
[*] Revolver and Assault Rifle now function as a secondary weapon with a skill cooldown
[*] Animation added for holstering the secondary weapon at the end of the skill cooldown
[*] A bar showing the active time remaining and skill regeneration has been added
[*] Collider for the portal without the gate model has been removed
[*] Environment improvements have been made to the force fields
[*] Simple colliders on objects have been corrected
[*] Crossbow accuracy has been improved, and arrow flight speed increased
[*] Animated lever usage added to open passages
[*] Demon orb point rewards have been rebalanced
[/list]

We hope that these changes enhance your gameplay experience, and we encourage you to share your feedback with us. Join our Discord community and stay up-to-date with the latest Bloodhound news, updates, and events. Don't forget to Wishlist Bloodhound on Steam to be notified when the full game is released!

Thank you for playing Bloodhound prologue!

notes.title: Patch 1.8 Live
notes.content:
Welcome Bloodhound fans! The demons have been busy down here, making some adjustments to our prologue. Here are the changes you'll find in new patch for First Day in Hell:

[list]
[*] Rebalanced the number of Cuppidyns on Arena 2 and the Blood Tree Arena in Level 1 Act I.
[*] Adjusted the number of Cuppidyns that appear after picking up the Green Key in Level 1 Act I.
[*] Improved the AI's ability to detect Navmesha, so they won't get stuck in a synchronized ballet anymore.
[*] Fixed some issues with the Gib Body.
[*] Fixed texture of the Demon Priestess's Tier 2 damage display.
[*] Continuing to work on reworking the simple colliders in Level 1 Act I.
[*] Optimized the streaming of levels for a smoother experience.
[/list]

These changes should make your descent into Hell even more challenging. The gates of Hell are always open, and the demons are waiting for you. Keep fighting, and we'll see you on the other side.

notes.title: Patch 1.5 Available Now
notes.content:
We are thrilled to announce that the latest update for Bloodhound "First Day In Hell" is now available on Steam. This patch includes several fixes and improvements that we hope will enhance your gaming experience.

Here are the changes in this update:

- Added an icon to the HUD to indicate the inability to make quick saves during combat
- Quick save now works correctly on F5/F9, and players can load their quick save from the loading menu
- Quick saves are now displayed on the loading menu
- The Blade Dancer no longer triggers damage reflection during death
- The Assault Cultist will no longer run between levels when changing positions between series
- Blocked save option during combat should now work correctly
- Power-ups no longer disappear between levels
- The specular intensity on the environment has been improved
- Collider fixes have been applied to assets on the arenas and the environment, preventing Cupidyns from falling into cracks
- The patrol path for the Berserks on the first map has been fixed
- The game's music has been diversified
- Players can now see the damage dealt more clearly as the effect of blood has been increased
- The rotation speed of the Berserk during combat has been improved
- The gib body now works correctly
- The spawn rotation for Cupidyns on the third map has been fixed
- The Berserk's pull in the mine on the first map has been improved
- The boss's HP has been increased
- Both save and quick save now save the difficulty level changed in settings
- The gib body on the exploding demon has been fixed, and the model no longer stretches after an explosion
- More fun gore has been added to the gib body, and it now works correctly on dead opponents

We believe that these changes will make the gameplay experience more enjoyable and seamless for our players. We want to thank you for your continued support, and we hope that you will enjoy this latest update.

If you encounter any issues or have any feedback, please do not hesitate to let us know. We are always looking for ways to improve and enhance our game to meet your expectations.

notes.title: Patch 1.3 Available
notes.content:
Attention all Bloodhound prologue players! We're excited to announce a new patch update that includes several fixes and improvements to the game. Let's take a look at some of the changes that have been made.

• Improved collider for easier pickup of items such as medkits and ammo placed on the map.
• Fixed a bug with the camera in the pause menu that unlocked the game while exiting settings with the Esc key.
• Fixed a bug with picking up demon orbs that were dropping from Cuppidyns, now you can pick them up.
• Fixed a bug with disappearing keybinds in settings.
• Fixed a bug with difficulty level not refreshing in settings.
• Changing the difficulty level in settings during gameplay now works correctly.

Thank you for playing "First Day in Hell" and we hope these updates will enhance your gaming experience.

notes.title: Patch 1.1 Available
notes.content:
Greetings Bloodhound community!

We are excited to announce the latest patch for Bloodhound prologue "First Day In Hell", which includes several improvements and fixes that will make your gaming experience smoother and more enjoyable. Here's what you can expect from the latest update:

- Fixed the camera menu and save menu to ensure smoother navigation.
- Fixed issues related to Demon Souls and guns, ensuring that these elements work as intended.
- Fixed the master volume issue to ensure that the sound levels are consistent throughout the game.
- Fixed the gun animation and the order of weapons under the numeric keypad, making it easier to switch between them.
- Added a pickup for Demon Souls and included information about them and player skills in the tutorial under the Q key.
- Added a new player skill that temporarily increases damage when using Demon Souls.
- Fixed a crash issue in the arena and during boss fights.
- Improving the colider.
- Improving the accuracy of weapons to shoot more accurately in relation to the sight.
- Fixed game save issues so that saves no longer disappear. Improved the order of game saves, with the latest save appearing at the top of the list.
- Fix to keybind options - removing outdated mechanics from options for assigning keyboard shortcuts.

We hope that these changes will enhance your experience and help you enjoy the game to the fullest. Thank you for playing Bloodhound, and stay tuned for more updates in the future!
